# Tutorial

**Learning-oriented.** Tutorials take a beginner from zero to a working
result by guiding them through concrete, opinionated steps. They are the
first place a new user lands.

:::note WI-S18-002 will populate this section
The 5-minute Bazel / Buck2 / native CLI quickstart will be added in
WI-S18-002 (Getting started + REAPI auto-gen). This page is the section
header established by the WI-S18-001 foundation.
:::

## Planned tutorials

- **Build your first cached project in 5 minutes** — Bazel, Buck2, and
  the native CLI variants.
- **From zero to a CI-integrated cache** — add CoreLink to an existing
  GitHub Actions pipeline.
- **First DSR export** — request your data, verify the dedup manifest.

See the [Diátaxis tutorial guide](https://diataxis.fr/tutorials/) for the
authoring conventions PR review enforces.
